# Raw Delete — verify raw file deletion with manifest update and sources scan

# Setup: initialize a KB
exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# --- Write a raw file ---
stdin ../csv-input.txt
exec akb raw write data.csv
stdout 'Written to raw/data.csv'

# --- Delete the raw file ---
exec akb raw delete data.csv
stdout 'Deleted raw/data.csv'

# --- Verify file is removed from disk ---
! exists raw/data.csv

# --- Verify manifest entry is removed ---
exec akb raw list
! stdout 'data.csv'

# --- Write and delete a file in subdirectory ---
stdin ../logo-input.txt
exec akb raw write images/logo.png
stdout 'Written to raw/images/logo.png'

exec akb raw delete images/logo.png
stdout 'Deleted raw/images/logo.png'

! exists raw/images/logo.png

exec akb raw list
! stdout 'images/logo.png'

# --- Sources scan: write raw file, create KB page referencing it, then delete ---
stdin ../csv-input.txt
exec akb raw write data.csv
stdout 'Written to raw/data.csv'

stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write source-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/source-note.md'

# Delete the raw file — should warn about source reference
exec akb raw delete data.csv
stdout 'Deleted raw/data.csv'
stdout 'Pages referencing this file: notes/source-note.md'

# --- Sources scan with list of sources ---
stdin ../csv-input.txt
exec akb raw write data.csv
stdout 'Written to raw/data.csv'

stdin ../multi-input.md
exec akb write multi-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/multi-note.md'

exec akb raw delete data.csv
stdout 'Deleted raw/data.csv'
stdout 'Pages referencing this file: notes/multi-note.md'

# --- Delete with raw/ prefix ---
stdin ../csv-input.txt
exec akb raw write test.csv
stdout 'Written to raw/test.csv'

exec akb raw delete raw/test.csv
stdout 'Deleted raw/test.csv'

! exists raw/test.csv

# --- Cross-namespace guard: akb delete raw/test.txt errors ---
stdin ../csv-input.txt
exec akb raw write test.txt
stdout 'Written to raw/test.txt'

! exec akb delete raw/test.txt
stderr 'akb raw delete'

# --- Block deleting files.log ---
! exec akb raw delete files.log
stderr 'managed file'

# --- Delete non-existent file returns error ---
! exec akb raw delete nonexistent.csv
stderr 'raw file not found'

# --- Delete with --no-commit flag ---
stdin ../csv-input.txt
exec akb raw write nocommit.csv
stdout 'Written to raw/nocommit.csv'

exec akb raw delete nocommit.csv --no-commit
stdout 'Deleted raw/nocommit.csv'

! exists raw/nocommit.csv

-- csv-input.txt --
hello

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Data Source Note
sources: data.csv
---
Note referencing data.csv

-- multi-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Multi Source Note
sources:
  - data.csv
  - other.txt
---
Note referencing multiple sources

-- logo-input.txt --
logodata
